content.text: Siangpahrang Lemuel lawk,
a manu ni a cangkhai e naw teh:
Bangtelane ka capa, bangtelane ka khe e capa,
bangtelane ka lawkkam capa.
Siangpahrangnaw patenghai karaphoekung napui koe
na thaonae poe hanh.
Aw Lemuel, misurtui nei e hoi yamu nei e teh
siangpahrangnaw hane nahoeh.
Hoehpawiteh, net awh vaiteh
kâlawk pahnim awh vaiteh mathoenaw hanelah
kalanhoehe lah lawkceng awh langvaih.
Meimei kadout e hah yamu pânei awh nateh,
lungrei ka thai e hah misurtui pânei awh.
Net awh naseh, a reithainae hah pahnim awh naseh,
a lungmathoenae pahnim totouh net awh naseh.
Lawkanaw hanlah dei pouh nateh,
due hanelah lawk tâtueng pouh e naw hane hai dei pouh.
Kalan lah lawkceng nateh tamimathoe hoi
tamikavout hanlah kâhet pouh.
Yu kahawi apinimaw a hmu thai han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh talung phukaawm hlak hai aphuohnawn.
A vâ ni a lungthin hoi a kâuep teh hawinae awm laipalah
awm mahoeh.
A hring nathung thoenae laipalah
hawinae dueng doeh a sak pouh.
Tumuen hoi pahla hah a tawng teh
a kut hoi amahmawk ouk a tawk.
Hno ka yawt e long patetlah ao teh,
ahlanae koehoi rawca ouk a thokhai.
Amom a thaw teh a imthungnaw hah rawca a paca teh,
a sannunaw hah thaw rip a boun.
Lawhmuen hah a khet teh a ran,
a tawkphu hoi misur takha a sak.
A keng dawk tha a kâyeng teh,
a kuttha hai a patung.
Hno a yo e a mek tie a panue dawkvah
tangmin patenghai hmaiim dout hoeh.
A kut hoi rahakut a kuet teh,
avanglae kut hoi yâcung a kuet.
Tamimathoe hanelah a kut a kâyap,
bokheiyah kavoutnaw totouh a kut ni koung a pha.
Tadamtui ka bawt nakunghai
a imthungnaw hanelah taki hane awm hoeh,
bangkongtetpawiteh a imthungnaw ni
dikpalingca e khohna kabet e a khohna awh.
Ama hanlah hni a kawng teh,
loukloukkaang e hoi pu doeh a khohna.
A vâ hai kho longkha koe khobawinaw hoi
a tahung toteh mithmaiben e lah ao.
Loukloukkaang e hni a kawng teh a yo,
hno kayawtnaw koe taisawm hah a yo.
A kawng e khohna teh a khaw,
ahawi dawkvah ahni teh hmalah a konawm han.
Lungangnae hoi lawk a dei,
a lawk teh pahrennae kâlawk lah ao.
A imthung khosaknae kahawicalah koung a khetyawt,
rawca hai pamda laihoi cat boihoeh.
A canaw a thaw awh teh a manu koe a lunghawi awh.
A vâ ni hai a oup van,
napui kapap ni kahawicalah a tawk awh toe,
hatei nang ni ahnimanaw na tapuet toe, atipouh.
Raimonae teh dumnae doeh,
meihawinae hai a yawmyin doeh.
Hatei BAWIPA ka taket e napui teh oup lah ao han.
A kut hoi a tawk e a paw hah poe awh nateh,
longkha koe ama roeroe hah a tawk e ni oup naseh.
